title: Detailed present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boxGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a6e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d92b47'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lidGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7f8f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e63a55'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ribbonGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f5b800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bowGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff2a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0a800'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow under box -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='34' ry='5' fill='#3a1a2a'/>

  <!-- box body -->
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='60' height='40' rx='5' fill='url(#boxGrad)'/>

  <!-- box body shading -->
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='60' height='40' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fa0' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- box lid -->
  <rect x='15' y='38' width='70' height='14' rx='4' fill='url(#lidGrad)'/>
  <rect x='15' y='38' width='70' height='14' rx='4' fill='none' stroke='#ffa8b4' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- vertical ribbon on body -->
  <rect x='44' y='48' width='12' height='40' fill='url(#ribbonGrad)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='48' width='12' height='40' fill='none' stroke='#fff0a0' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- vertical ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x='44' y='38' width='12' height='14' fill='url(#ribbonGrad)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='38' width='12' height='14' fill='none' stroke='#fff0a0' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- horizontal ribbon across lid -->
  <rect x='15' y='44' width='70' height='4' fill='#ffcf40' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- bow loops -->
  <path d='M50 38 C 36 24, 20 24, 24 34 C 27 41, 42 40, 50 38 Z' fill='url(#bowGrad)' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M50 38 C 64 24, 80 24, 76 34 C 73 41, 58 40, 50 38 Z' fill='url(#bowGrad)' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- bow inner shadows -->
  <path d='M50 38 C 40 30, 30 29, 27 34 C 29 37, 40 37, 50 38 Z' fill='#e89a00' opacity='0.45'/>
  <path d='M50 38 C 60 30, 70 29, 73 34 C 71 37, 60 37, 50 38 Z' fill='#e89a00' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- bow center knot -->
  <rect x='46' y='34' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ffd94a' stroke='#fff2a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- bow tails -->
  <path d='M46 41 L 40 52 L 44 52 L 48 43 Z' fill='url(#ribbonGrad)' stroke='#fff0a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M54 41 L 60 52 L 56 52 L 52 43 Z' fill='url(#ribbonGrad)' stroke='#fff0a0' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#fff8d0'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#fff8d0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='33' r='1' fill='#fff8d0'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='35' r='1' fill='#fff8d0'/>

  <!-- lid highlight -->
  <rect x='20' y='40' width='20' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffb8c4' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
